verdict.rationale: Adyen's own platform docs describe user-level risk tooling: identifying fraudulent behavior, flagging unusual user activities, stopping suspicious payouts, and configuring monitoring rules and mitigations (or outsourcing them to Adyen). Funds can also be held until payout. This covers fraud monitoring, anomaly flagging and payout pausing, but only in brief marketing and overview statements. Missing for 10: per-sub-merchant credit-risk signals, documented alerting mechanics for anomalous sellers, an explicit offboarding/deactivation tool for bad actors, in-depth docs on the risk dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can watch risk across my seller portfolio — fraud and credit-risk signals per sub-merchant, alerts on anomalous sellers, and tools to pause payouts or offboard bad actors

citations.quote: identify fraudulent behavior, stop suspicious payouts, and flag unusual user activities.
Outsource financial user risk management to Adyen or use Adyen's custom tools to configure your own monitoring rules and mitigations
